text.offer: Thank the gods you're here! I think I'm dying! I've got pelagalosilis! Go to Lady Aftyn, the healer in Marion, and ask her about a cure for it!
text.complete: Oh, thank the gods! I... I was seeing stars! The light at the end of the tunnel! I'm alive! Here, take this: I owe it to you for saving my life!

steps.objective: Ask Lady Aftyn about a cure
Ask Joguer for a Sacchaqua potion
steps.brief: Ah, he's dying, eh? Well, why don't you go to Joguer in Barloque and say that Frisconar needs another Sacchaqua potion.
How very amusing. You would think an accomplished apothecary like Frisconar would know that this is nothing more than sugar water. Well, take this to him.
